moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio grid-diagonal, written here): 4×4 tiles (28 px, 34 px pitch) slide in from the lower-left: x −18 → 0, y +18 → 0 px, opacity in over the first half, each 472 ms power3.out, delay (row + col) × 78 ms (940 ms in all); tiles on one diagonal arrive together (alternate diagonals in two colours, delay labels in the demo). Params: offset (−18, +18 px) · step (78 ms) · each (0.472 s) · ease (power3.out). Tiles on one diagonal arrive together.
